title: The weighted Max-Cut conjecture for one-round binary feedback: proof and equality cases
description: Exact proof certificate and equality classification for the weighted cut–imbalance inequality (Braverman–Efremenko–Kol–Saxena–Zhang, ITCS Conjecture 3 / ECCC Conjecture 1.3). The only nonzero equality graphs are the equally weighted triangle and five-clique, up to isolated vertices. This archive snapshots the proof, source comparisons, internal reviews and standard-library verification scripts from mxym/math pull requests #123 and #127. AI-assisted research; no external peer review. It does not concern the separate degree-square conjecture.
